description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Elemental Plane of Earth, its body dissolves into dirt, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Earth.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has a 30 percent chance of knowing the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can understand. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts the spell for the creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has cast it three times, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't do so again for 365 days.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item .F6dsMn8XnfbA4f4k]] attacks or two [[/item .Bqjrs1BefToGGRLw]] attacks.
